dove-resta-il-documento.domanda: You write a letter, save it and turn the computer off. Which component does the letter stay in?

feedback.ram: RAM empties when the computer turns off: it's for the work in progress, not for keeping things.
feedback.processore: The processor executes instructions, but it doesn't keep documents.
feedback.schermo: The screen shows things, it doesn't keep them.

suggerimenti: The computer is off: which component remembers things even without power?
In the kitchen analogy, what stays full even when the cook goes home?
On the disk: it's the only one of the three components that keeps data while the computer is off. That's why “saving” means copying from RAM to the disk.
dove-resta-il-documento.spiegazione: Saving means copying data from RAM to the disk. RAM empties when the computer turns off, the disk doesn't: that's why a saved document is still there when you turn the computer back on.

cosa-e-hardware.domanda: Which of these are hardware? Choose all the right answers.

feedback.browser: The browser is a program: it's made of instructions, you can't touch it. It's software.
feedback.gioco: A video game is made of instructions: it's software, even if you play it with a controller (which is hardware).

suggerimenti: Hardware is everything you could touch with your hands.
Two of the answers are programs, that is instructions.
The keyboard, the processor and RAM are hardware. The browser and the video game are software.
cosa-e-hardware.spiegazione: Keyboard, processor and RAM are physical objects: hardware. Browser and video game are instructions: software, which however needs hardware to run.

compito-del-kernel.domanda: What is the main job of the kernel?

opzioni.finestre: Drawing windows and icons on the screen
opzioni.hardware: Managing the hardware and letting programs use it in an orderly way

feedback.finestre: Windows and icons are handled by other programs of the operating system, not by the kernel.
feedback.internet: To browse you need a browser. The kernel manages the network card, but it doesn't browse.
feedback.virus: An antivirus is a separate program. The kernel protects programs from each other, but it isn't an antivirus.

suggerimenti: In the restaurant analogy, the kernel is the most central part of the manager.
The kernel is the piece of the operating system that talks directly to processor, memory and disk.
The right answer is: managing the hardware and letting programs use it in an orderly way.
compito-del-kernel.spiegazione: The kernel is the heart of the operating system: it talks to the hardware and every program has to go through it to use it. This is exactly what will let Docker isolate containers.

numero-del-processo.domanda: Complete the sentence with the right acronym.
numero-del-processo.modello: The kernel gives each process a unique number, called the ___ .
feedbackSpazi: It's a three-letter acronym for Process IDentifier.
suggerimenti: The answer is in the lesson “Programs and processes”.
It's a three-letter acronym: Process IDentifier.
The answer is PID.
numero-del-processo.spiegazione: PID stands for Process IDentifier. The kernel uses it to tell processes apart, and there can be hundreds of them even when the computer seems to be doing nothing.

percorso-della-foto.domanda: To reach the file /home/studente/foto/mare.jpg, in which order do you go through the folders and the file? Put them in order from first to last.
suggerimenti: A path is read from left to right.
Every path that starts with / starts from the root of the file system.
The order is: / (root), home, studente, foto, mare.jpg.
percorso-della-foto.spiegazione: A path is read from left to right: you start from the root /, go into home, then into studente, then into foto, and there's the file mare.jpg.

versione-correzione.domanda: A library that follows Semantic Versioning is at version 2.4.1. A new version comes out that only fixes a bug, with nothing new. What number will it have?
feedbackSpazi: A fix only changes the last number: the other two stay the same.
suggerimenti: Remember the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
Only the part that indicates bug fixes changes.
The answer is 2.4.2.
versione-correzione.spiegazione: With Semantic Versioning a fix only increases the last number: from 2.4.1 you go to 2.4.2. People using the library can update safely.

sul-mio-computer-funziona.domanda: An application works on the computer of the person who wrote it, but not on the server. Which of these can be the causes? Choose all the right answers.

opzioni.libreria-mancante: The server is missing a library the application depends on.
opzioni.versione-diversa: The server has the same library, but in a different version.
opzioni.schermo-diverso: The server has a smaller screen.
opzioni.sistema-diverso: The server has a different operating system or distribution.
opzioni.nome-file: The application's file has a name that is too long.

feedback.schermo-diverso: Servers usually don't even have a screen: the application doesn't depend on it.
feedback.nome-file: The file name isn't a typical problem: the classic causes are different dependencies and environments.

suggerimenti: Think about what an application needs to work, besides its own code.
Three of the five answers are about dependencies or the environment the application runs in.
The right answers are: missing library, different library version, different operating system or distribution.
sul-mio-computer-funziona.spiegazione: An application depends on its environment: libraries, versions, operating system. If even one of these is different on the server, the application may not work. It's exactly the problem Docker solves.
